name: KARYON
recent: KARYON 于 2026 年 9 月 28 日完成收购一块永久工业用地及一栋独立厂房；此前于 9 月 9 日举行第 23 届常年股东大会，所有议案以 100% 赞成票通过。公司宣派 2026 财年每股 0.45 仙中期单层股息，除息日为 9 月 10 日，派发日为 9 月 29 日。两名董事在闭市期前申报有意交易公司股份。
notable: 全资子公司 Hsing Lung Sdn Bhd 完成收购一块永久工业用地及一栋独立厂房。
第 23 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 9 日举行，所有议案以 100% 赞成票通过。
宣派 2026 财年每股 0.45 仙中期单层股息。
risks: 两名董事 Loh Chen Yook 与 Loh Fatt Chong 在闭市期前申报有意交易公司股份。

recent_en: KARYON completed the acquisition of a piece of freehold industrial land together with a detached factory on 28 September 2026. Its 23rd AGM was held on 9 September 2026, with all resolutions passed by 100% votes in favour. The company declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.45 sen per share for FY2026, with ex-date on 10 September and payment date on 29 September. Two directors declared their intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Hsing Lung Sdn Bhd completed the acquisition of a piece of freehold industrial land together with a detached factory.
The 23rd AGM was held on 9 September 2026, with all resolutions passed by 100% votes in favour.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.45 sen per share for FY2026.
risks_en: Two directors, Loh Chen Yook and Loh Fatt Chong, declared their intention to deal in the company's shares during the closed period.
